description: Implementation of TServerFramework class for managing server connections, client handling, and transport protocols in Thrift server.

classes.name: TServerFramework
classes.description: A server class managing client connections, transport protocols, and server lifecycle in Thrift.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Main server loop accepting and processing client connections.

methods.name: getConcurrentClientLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of concurrent clients allowed.

methods.name: getConcurrentClientCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of connected clients.

methods.name: getConcurrentClientCountHWM
methods.description: Returns the high-water mark of concurrent clients.

methods.name: setConcurrentClientLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent clients.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server by interrupting transport and client handling.

methods.name: newlyConnectedClient
methods.description: Handles logic when a new client connects.

methods.name: disposeConnectedClient
methods.description: Cleans up resources when a client disconnects.
